title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - EnergyAndPowerProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/EnergyAndPowerProperty. Class to group those properties related to the energy and power of power lines. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). SAREF4GRID does not aim to provide an exhaustive definition of all the properties defined in IEC 62056-6-2; instead it defines this set of general, named individual properties (listed in the propertyType enum below, e.g. s4grid:ActiveEnergy, s4grid:Voltage) and lets more specific, meter/OBIS-specific properties be related to them via SKOS (skos:broader/skos:narrower). This model represents one instance of such a (general or specific) property.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EnergyAndPowerProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

propertyType.description: Property. The specific kind of energy/power property this instance represents, drawn from the SAREF4GRID controlled vocabulary of named EnergyAndPowerProperty individuals (the 'general' properties of Figures 14-15 of the specification); a meter/OBIS-specific property narrower than one of these can reference it via broaderPropertyType.

broaderPropertyType.description: Property (skos:broader). When this instance represents a specific, narrower, OBIS-identified property (e.g. 'TotalIncrementalActiveEnergyImport'), this names the general EnergyAndPowerProperty individual it specializes.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code identifying this power-line property instance.

unitOfMeasure.description: Property. Unit of measure of the property's values, where defined (om:... unit from the Ontology of units of Measure referenced by SAREF4GRID).
